Tool: built-in image_gen / imagegen skill. Transparent PNG sprite atlas generated for this project.
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel RPG companion animation spritesheet, one single atlas. Make a transparent PNG, landscape 1536x1024, exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, no padding outside cells, no lines, no text. Every creature fully fits its own cell with generous transparent margin. Row 1: the SAME gray silver wolf facing right in four successive frames (standing alert, running extended, running gathered, lunging bite with open jaw). Row 2: the SAME brown golden hawk facing right in four successive frames (wings high, wings level, wings down, steep forward dive with talons extended). Row 3: the SAME bulky brown bear facing right in four successive frames (standing quadrupedal, walking, rearing forepaws up, smashing forepaws down). Pure crisp 16-bit pixel art, dark 2 pixel outline, carefully shaded fur and feathers, bright eyes, charming but fierce Korean fantasy game style. Wolf has long muzzle, pointed ears, bushy tail and four legs; hawk has unmistakable feathered wings, hooked beak and talons; bear has round ears, enormous heavy shoulders and large clawed paws. Top down three-quarter RPG perspective, consistent scale within each row, each frame centered at the same baseline within its cell. This is animated game art, not icons or vector polygons. Do not add people, scenery, circles, letters, weapons or magical particles. All empty space genuinely transparent.
Integration: alpha-preserving crop and nearest-neighbor atlas packing by scripts/build-rpg-archer-fx.py. Original generated alpha retained. GIFs use the same frames, with a green preview background only.
